items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets, flush coolant and change oil
items.note: Owners report $400 to $1,200. More if the upper intake is cracked or coolant damaged the engine bearings.

items.t: Plastic upper intake manifold cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace upper intake manifold with revised part and gaskets

items.t: Backfire when starting can break the upper intake manifold (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine computer (recall)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Leaking fuel pressure regulator can cause a backfire and fire (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pressure regulator (recall 04V-090)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Power window falls into the door or stops working
items.job: Replace power window regulator
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $300 to $400 at a shop.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or loses gears
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Based on reported costs for the same GM 4-speed automatic in the related Buick Century. A used transmission may cost less.

items.t: Harsh or erratic shifting from a failing pressure control solenoid
items.job: Replace transmission pressure control solenoid

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or sticks
items.job: Replace fuel pump module with level sender
items.note: The sender is part of the fuel pump module, so the whole module is usually replaced.

items.t: Fuel pump failure causes stalling or no start
items.job: Replace fuel pump module

items.t: Anti-theft system blocks starting (security light on)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder or security sensor and relearn

items.t: Blower or climate control stops working
items.job: Replace blower control module or climate programmer

items.t: Clunking from worn front strut mounts
items.job: Replace front strut mounts or complete strut assemblies (pair) and align

items.t: Front wheel bearing hums and sets the ABS light
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Inner tie rod nuts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Tighten inner tie rod nuts and set toe (recall 99V-301)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Loose brake booster nuts can affect braking (recall)
items.job: Install and torque brake booster nuts (recall 99V-238)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: ABS unit can leak internally (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace ABS hydraulic unit (recall 00V-114)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Headlight aim adjuster does not work (recall)
items.job: Owner manual insert with optical aiming steps (recall 99V-355)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can fracture (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace driver airbag module (recall 02V-222)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Steering gear bolts missing or loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque steering gear bolts (recall 02V-067)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Chimes, interior lights or power locks act up (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace alarm, lighting and locking module
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Harsh clunk into reverse or drive when cold
items.job: Diagnose transmission and perform bulletin repair
items.note: Cost depends on the bulletin repair needed.
